name: Roast Day
tagline: Every part of the roast dinner, ready at the same minute
about: Roast Day builds a minute-by-minute countdown for the whole roast — joint, potatoes, veg, Yorkshires and gravy — fits it all in one oven, and turns the leftovers into three more dinners.
persona: You are an unflappable roast-dinner conductor: exact on weights, temperatures and resting times, and always making the gravy from the tray.

onboarding.title: Sunday, sorted
onboarding.subtitle: Tell Roast Day about your oven and your usual table.
bullets: Oven shelf plan for every side

tools.title: The countdown
tools.subtitle: From joint weight to serving time
tools.prompt: Build a countdown to serve {joint} with {sides} at {serve} in the profile's oven for the profile's people. kv (oven temp(s), total roast minutes, rest minutes, target internal temp), a table (Clock time | Action | Shelf) from the first prep step to plating, a checklist of things to do the night before, and a callout on resting and safe internal temperatures.

tools.title: Fit it all in
tools.subtitle: Oven shelf plan when everything wants 200°

inputs.label: Everything that needs the oven
inputs.placeholder: beef at 180, potatoes at 220, Yorkshires at 230, stuffing…

tools.prompt: Plan {dishes} across the profile's shelves and oven type: a table (Dish | Temp it wants | Shelf | In at | Out at | Compromise), steps for the swap sequence while the joint rests, and bullets on what can be done on the hob or finished under the grill instead.

tools.title: Gravy & sauces
tools.subtitle: From the tray, never from a packet

inputs.label: What's in the tray
inputs.placeholder: beef fat and juices, some burnt onion

tools.prompt: Make a {style} gravy from {juices} for the profile's people: steps with quantities, a kv (fat to keep, flour, liquid, simmer minutes), a table (Problem | Fix) for lumpy, thin, greasy and bitter, and bullets on the one sauce or condiment that matches the joint.

tools.title: Sides that shine
tools.subtitle: Potatoes, Yorkshires, veg — done right
tools.prompt: The perfect {side} for {guests} people in the profile's oven: kv (ingredients with grams, temp, minutes), steps with the make-or-break detail called out, bullets on making ahead, and a quote with the one rule that matters most.

tools.title: Leftover roast
tools.subtitle: Three more dinners from what's left

inputs.label: What's left
inputs.placeholder: half a chicken, potatoes, a bit of gravy

tools.prompt: Turn {left} into 3 dinners this week as cards (meta = minutes · serves), steps for the best one, and a callout on how long cooked meat keeps, cooling it fast and reheating piping hot only once.

disclaimer: Cooking times are estimates; use a meat thermometer and follow food-safety guidance for reheating.
